period_note: Balance sheet is the 31-Mar-2026 period-end snapshot (reported), Solo basis. Income statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2026 (Q1 = 3 months), matching this bank's established quarterly convention. Source PDF is a 2-page newspaper-spread-style scan (pdftotext extracted 0 lines despite the file being 22MB -- two very large, very high-resolution pages); this bank's own Q1 filing unusually bundles BOTH a Consolidated ('ONE Bank PLC and its Subsidiaries') set of statements AND a separate Solo ('ONE Bank PLC') set side-by-side on the same pages -- the Solo set was used, consistent with this bank's established basis. Figures were read directly off the rendered page images (pdftoppm 200dpi, cropped into quadrants for legibility), not tesseract OCR'd -- text was legible enough for direct reading. Cross-checked against this filing's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column, which matches this dataset's existing 2025_Q4.json exactly for total_assets (360,112.870901m), total_liabilities (336,745.540023m), total_equity (23,367.330879m), paid_up_capital (10,658.21887m) and off_balance_sheet_exposures (63,801.435009m). Balance-sheet identity holds exactly (343,301.786072 + 23,748.661103 = 367,050.447175). Income statement fully reconciles: operating_profit = total_operating_income - total_operating_expenses (2,666.637812-1,805.721022=860.91679 exact); profit_before_tax = operating_profit - total_provision (860.91679-495.36136=365.55543 exact); profit_after_tax = profit_before_tax - tax_expense (365.55543-37.424251=328.131179 exact); tax_expense = current_tax + deferred_tax (54.334576+(-16.910325)=37.424251 exact, deferred tax was a modest INCOME this quarter, i.e. a credit). eps_cumulative (0.31) is independently corroborated: profit_after_tax_cumulative (328.131179m) / 1,065.821887m weighted-average shares = 0.3078, rounds to the reported 0.31. No classified-loan/NPL breakdown is disclosed anywhere in this condensed filing (checked across both pages) -- only available annually; npl_pct is intentionally omitted here, consistent with this bank's other interim quarters in this dataset.
